desc: On November 15th, President Trump began the morning with Executive Time at the White House before departing at 10:14 a.m. for Trump National Golf Club Washington DC. He arrived at the club at 10:45 a.m. and stayed until 1:26 p.m. The President returned to the White House at 2:02 p.m., shortly before the White House Press Office called a travel/photo lid at 2:09 p.m.
summary: President Trump spent November 15th in Washington, D.C., visiting Trump National Golf Club Washington DC before returning to the White House in the afternoon.
